result.instructions: Tools for Transifex, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our projects still have untranslated strings, and for which languages?"; "List the translation tasks that are open in our organization and when they are due."; "Show the translation progress for the French language in the website project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Transifex data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run transifex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run transifex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run transifex_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. transifex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: transifex_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one Transifex user by id: name, username and account details the token can see. Use it to check who the token belongs to. Transifex API: GET /users/{user_id}.

user_id.description: The user id (the id of the token owner works).

tools.name: transifex_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the token belongs to, with their slugs and ids. Start here to find the organization id for other tools. Transifex API: GET /organizations.

slug.description: Only return the organization with this slug.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Get one organization by id: name, slug and settings. Transifex API: GET /organizations/{organization_id}.

tools.name: transifex_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects of one organization: name, slug, archived state and target languages. Transifex API: GET /projects (filter[organization] is required).

slug.description: Only return the project with this slug.

name.description: Only return projects whose name matches.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id: name, description, privacy, archived state and maintainers. Transifex API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: transifex_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a new project in an organization with a name, slug and privacy flag. It only creates; it deletes nothing and adds no translations. A repeat with the same slug fails and changes nothing. Transifex API: POST /projects.

slug.description: Unique slug for the project inside the organization.

private.description: true makes the project private to the organization.

tools.name: transifex_list_languages
tools.title: List languages
tools.description: List the languages Transifex supports, with codes, names and plural rules. Use it to check a language code before you use it in other tools. Transifex API: GET /languages.

code.description: Only return the language with this code, for example fr or pt_BR.

tools.name: transifex_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List the resources (translatable files) of one project: name, slug, priority and categories. Transifex API: GET /resources (filter[project] is required).

name.description: Only return resources whose name matches.

slug.description: Only return the resource with this slug.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_get_resource
tools.title: Get a resource
tools.description: Get one resource by id: name, slug, priority, categories and whether it accepts translations. Transifex API: GET /resources/{resource_id}.

tools.name: transifex_list_resource_strings
tools.title: List source strings
tools.description: List the source strings of one resource: key, source text, context and tags, a page at a time. Transifex API: GET /resource_strings (filter[resource] is required).

key.description: Only return the string with this key.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_list_resource_language_stats
tools.title: List translation progress
tools.description: Show translation progress per resource and language: translated, reviewed and proofread counts and last update times. Transifex API: GET /resource_language_stats (filter[project] is required).

resource.description: Only return stats for this resource.

language.description: Only return stats for this language id, for example l:fr.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List translation tasks of one organization: name, status, languages, due date and owner. Transifex API: GET /tasks (filter[organization] is required).

project.description: Only return tasks of this project.

language_code.description: Only return tasks for this language code.

statuses.description: Comma-separated task statuses, for example open,in_progress.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.

tools.name: transifex_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one translation task by id: name, status, languages, assignees, due date and completion time. Transifex API: GET /tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: transifex_list_glossaries
tools.title: List glossaries
tools.description: List the glossaries of one organization: name, slug and source language. Transifex API: GET /glossaries (filter[organization] is required).

name.description: Only return glossaries whose name matches.

slug.description: Only return the glossary with this slug.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page: pass the value from links.next of the previous response.
